notes: Added missing schema contract, integration wiring, and test coverage stories for FEAT-5.

stories.title: Tool Schema Registry and Pydantic Contract Definition
stories.description: Define a centralized schema registry mapping allowlisted tool names to their corresponding Pydantic models, ensuring a strict contract between tool invocation and validation layer.

stories.title: Tool Router Core Dispatch Execution Logic
stories.description: Implement the core dispatch mechanism that maps validated tool inputs to the correct domain service or facade method and executes the tool call with normalized inputs.

stories.title: FastAPI Integration with Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle within main.py, ensuring tool calls from the LLM loop are routed through the allowlist and validation pipeline.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Allowlist Routing and Validation
stories.description: Create unit tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure, and correct routing behavior for supported tools.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Invocation Integration Test
stories.description: Implement integration tests simulating full LLM tool_use flows, validating that tool calls pass through parsing, validation, routing, and execution layers correctly.
